marie: Quick sync 11 need to lock the next micro-iteration after launch. Candidates: embed regression fix (customer blocker), model-cache flag (cost win), convo-history polish, CSV export for pilots. Owners + acceptance criteria by EOD?
dan: embed fix P0 for me. CS is seeing a spike.
tasha: Agreed. I'll prioritize customer comms.
samir: I'll own model-cache flag as P1. Plan: per-model feature flag, prototype -> canary.
olga: I can do convo-history polish but low impact. Recommend defer if P0/P1 need headcount.
marie: Owners: A=embed -> dan + olga test, B=cache -> samir (+aj deploy), C=convo UX -> olga, D=CSV -> marie.
dan: Acceptance criteria for embed bug: reproduce customer case, PR + tests, canary 10% for 72h with no regressions, customer update sent.
samir: Cache acceptance: RFC + feature flag, prototype perf numbers (token cost delta), canary plan.
marie: Timeline check: customer asked for ETA within 3 weeks. Band it: 1wk optimistic / 3wk conservative. If model-side, escalate.
olga: starting repro now, will post logs to GH issue in 30m.
dan: created issue and checklist: https://github.com/redwood/product/issues/9999
marie: Reconvene Friday 10am PT. Ping #eng-oncall for blockers. :white_check_mark:
